text:
lena: Quick sanity check — we need a short decision on what telemetry headers the adapter can forward into Private runtimes. don’t want secrets leaking.
devon: Agree. Today adapters forward: trace-id, route-id, model-hint, and customer-ctx (opaque). is that list correct?
maria: customer-ctx is the risky one. contains tenant id and sometimes a short feature flag map. we should strip flags before sending to Private.
lena: Can we define a strict allowlist: trace-id, route-id, model-hint, tenant-id (hashed)? and drop anything labelled feature_flags or env?
devon: Hashing tenant-id makes debugging harder for infra teams. maybe we forward tenant-id only when encrypted via control-plane KMS token?
samir: ops-bot: Note: control-plane KMS token step increases request path latency by ~6-12ms in our staging tests.
maria: Good to call that out. For low-latency SLOs we can have two modes: "opaque-forward" (hash tenant) default, and "trusted-forward" (plain tenant) for Dedicated with tenant-whitelist.
lena: That matches earlier canary idea. How do we manage config? per-deployment flag in manifest?
devon: Add a field on the deployment manifest: "forwarding_profile": [opaque-default | trusted-whitelist]. Default to opaque-default. Whitelist maintained in control plane.
samir: Also need audit logs whenever we switch to trusted-whitelist and when a module requests plain tenant. compliance wants an immutable record.
maria: Agreed. Add an audit event with admin id, timestamp, reason.
lena: What about telemetry sampling? Private customers may not want full traces. adapters should respect sampling header and also be able to redact spans.
devon: Implementation note: adapter should expose a proto that accepts TelemetryEnvelope { trace_id, route_id, model_hint, meta_map } but meta_map must be validated against policy before forwarding. Keep validation logic in control-plane libs so adapters stay thin.
samir: Concern: keeping validation in control plane increases coupling. If control plane is unavailable, adapters need a fallback policy. ops-bot: Suggestion: fallback to local conservative policy (same as opaque-default).
maria: That's safe. Also add a debug toggle that can be enabled for 1h windows with audit trail for troubleshooting.
lena: Ok action items: 1) Devon to draft manifest schema change + migration notes. 2) Maria to write policy spec for meta_map sanitizers. 3) Samir to add audit event spec and fallback behavior. 4) I’ll update the runtime README with profiles and SLO implications.
devon: I’ll put a short RFC PR today, will include perf numbers for KMS path and recommended thresholds.
maria: If anyone wants a pair review on the policy spec ping me.
samir: ops-bot: Added tasks to eng-sprint board under ADAPTER-telemetry-surface.
lena: Thanks — if no objections I’ll lock this behaviour for the next release window. :thumbsup:
devon: +1
maria: +1
samir: +1
